title: 宝塚記念の後に・覚悟を刻みて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen sets the stage for yet another fierce Mejiro showdown. Mejiro Ryan displays her resolve and comes out victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to this, Mejiro McQueen realizes her own resolve is still lacking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that the Takarazuka Kinen is over, Mejiro McQueen sets the autumn Tenno Sho as her new goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with a dash, she's off to achieve what no one in her family has done before—successive wins in the Tenno Sho spring and autumn races.
